title: Add comment-embedded FileCheck AST fixture tests
description: Define a fixture convention modeled on ../slate/tests/fixtures: C source followed by comment directives containing the expected printed polyvariant AST. Add a runner that extracts directives, invokes the parser, prints a stable AST form, and runs FileCheck (including named prefixes for alternate configurations).
acceptance_criteria: At least one fixture exists for each Phase 3 parser slice; AST expectations are visible beside source, failures show FileCheck context, and the suite runs through cargo test.
notes: Migrated coverage to comment-embedded C fixtures and removed all src/tests unit tests except the single integration harness that discovers fixtures. Added src/render.rs and the slate-parser filecheck CLI, per-prefix fixture macro definitions, concrete branch evaluation output, FileCheck runner, three C fixtures plus include headers, and tools/update_filecheck.py. The generator runs cargo to render each configuration and either prints a unified diff or overwrites with --in-place. Validation: cargo test reports 0 unit tests and the fixture harness passes; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passes; generator reports no stale diff.
close_reason: All coverage migrated to generated comment-embedded FileCheck fixtures with macro-configured eval checks; zero unit tests remain and quality gates pass.

title: Expand canonical oracle projections
description: Extend the test-only clang JSON projection and our canonical summaries for declarations, types, expressions, initializers, attributes, and semantic diagnostics as features land.
acceptance_criteria: Oracle comparisons cover every supported AST construct without requiring wholesale clang AST import.

title: Build generated corpus and mutation workflows
description: Create source corpus generation, mutation, seeding, and minimization workflows that preserve useful preprocessor and parser structure.
acceptance_criteria: The harness produces reproducible inputs and minimized failures that can be promoted to generated FileCheck fixtures.

title: Run configuration-aware differential fuzzing
description: Exercise generated sources over randomized -D sets and compare preprocessing output, evaluated AST summaries, and diagnostics one concrete configuration at a time.
acceptance_criteria: Mismatches identify the source, define set, expected oracle result, and minimized reproducer.

title: Pin and invoke the clang oracle reproducibly
description: Define the clang version, invocation flags, AST/proprocessor modes, environment capture, and failure reporting used by differential tests.
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout can run the oracle with deterministic tool/version reporting and diagnose missing or mismatched clang setups.

title: Implement C type checking and implicit conversions
description: Add recursive type compatibility checks, lvalue rules, pointer conversions, integer promotions, usual arithmetic conversions, function calls, assignments, and return statements.
acceptance_criteria: Supported type errors and conversions produce ordered diagnostics with source provenance and are covered by generated FileCheck fixtures.

title: Complete constant-expression semantic validation
description: Validate integer constant expressions in contexts requiring them, including enumerators, array bounds, case labels, initializers, and static assertions, after configuration evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid constant expressions produce semantic diagnostics matching clang for supported constructs; valid expressions are accepted.

title: Resolve scopes, tags, and declarations
description: Build configuration-specific ordinary, typedef, label, and tag namespaces over the evaluated AST, including scope lifetimes, redeclarations, incomplete types, and shadowing.
acceptance_criteria: Semantic diagnostics agree with clang for supported scope and declaration cases under each supplied -D configuration.

title: Parse builtins, vectors, inline assembly, and remaining C23 syntax
description: Add opaque or typed parse-only representations for __builtin_* forms, vector extensions, inline asm, and C23 syntax not covered by attribute handling.
acceptance_criteria: Supported syntax is preserved losslessly enough for downstream consumers and every implemented form has FileCheck coverage.

title: Parse computed goto, nested functions, and VLAs
description: Add parse-only representations for computed goto, nested function definitions, and variable-length array declarators or expressions.
acceptance_criteria: Each construct parses with nested conditional content preserved and has generated FileCheck coverage.

title: Complete function and declaration attribute parsing
description: Finish the existing typed attribute work for function and declaration attributes, including placement rules and attributes that affect declarators or declarations.
acceptance_criteria: Supported GNU and Clang function/declaration attributes are represented in the AST and covered by generated FileCheck fixtures.

title: Parse generic selections and statement expressions
description: Add parse-only AST representation for _Generic selections and GNU statement expressions while preserving conditional branches inside them.
acceptance_criteria: Generic selections and statement expressions round-trip through generated FileCheck fixtures without requiring semantic resolution.

title: Integrate macro expansion with branch-aware parsing
description: Allow conditional token streams produced by macro expansion to create branch points anywhere the parser accepts tokens, including declarations, statements, expressions, and types.
acceptance_criteria: Macro-induced structural divergence parses into the same Conditional AST representation as direct preprocessor branches.

title: Represent conditional macro definitions and redefinitions
description: Replace the current simple macro state with conditional macro definitions keyed by branch conditions, retaining relevant provenance and source order across redefinitions and includes.
acceptance_criteria: Object-like and function-like macro definitions diverging across branches expand as conditional token streams and have generated FileCheck coverage.

title: Implement object-like macro expansion
description: Expand object-like macros recursively with replacement-list rules, disabled-macro recursion protection, and configuration-independent preservation of divergent expansions.
acceptance_criteria: Preprocessor output and parsed AST match clang for concrete configurations; polyvariant expansion is checked separately with generated FileCheck.

title: Implement function-like macro operators
description: Add function-like macro argument substitution, variadics and __VA_ARGS__, token stringification (#), token pasting (##), and rescanning rules.
acceptance_criteria: Macro operator fixtures are generated through the FileCheck updater and evaluated output matches clang for supported cases.

title: Complete nested conditional directive handling
description: Finish nested #if/#ifdef/#ifndef/#elif/#else/#endif handling, including condition evaluation and omission of inactive no-else branches, while preserving source-order branch structure.
acceptance_criteria: Nested directives produce correct Conditional nodes and malformed directive structure yields parser diagnostics in generated FileCheck fixtures.
close_reason: Implemented nested conditional parsing, #elif branch guards, and parser diagnostics for malformed conditional directives with generated FileCheck coverage.

title: Make typedef-name tracking branch-aware
description: Ensure parser grammar disambiguation tracks typedef declarations and removals per conditional branch, including uses after a branch merge.
acceptance_criteria: Cast-versus-call and declaration-versus-expression ambiguities resolve correctly under every selected branch and are covered by FileCheck.
close_reason: Added branch-local typedef environments with common-name merging and FileCheck coverage for typedef-driven cast versus call parsing.

title: Phase 4: GNU, Clang, and C23 extensions
description: Implement the parse-only extensions listed in README Phase 4. Preserve extension syntax in the polyvariant AST, use typed enums where the syntax has stable semantics, and retain unknown or unsupported attributes losslessly.
acceptance_criteria: Each supported extension has generated FileCheck coverage; parse-only behavior does not require complete semantic validation until Phase 6.

title: Phase 7: differential fuzzing harness hardening
description: Implement README Phase 7 corpus generation, clang pinning, randomized configuration selection, source generation or mutation, and differential comparison of diagnostics and reachable evaluated AST summaries.
acceptance_criteria: The harness can reproduce failures, compares one concrete configuration at a time against the pinned clang oracle, and records minimized regression fixtures as FileCheck tests.

title: Phase 5: concrete AST evaluation
description: Track README Phase 5 evaluation of the polyvariant AST against concrete macro and target environments. Evaluation must produce a conditional-free concrete AST and diagnose invalid multi-selected branches.
acceptance_criteria: The evaluated AST is conditional-free, configuration-dependent, and covered by FileCheck fixtures and the evaluated clang oracle where the modeled AST supports comparison. This phase is already implemented and is retained as a completed milestone.
close_reason: Phase 5 concrete AST evaluation is already implemented and covered by FileCheck and evaluated oracle fixtures.

title: Phase 2: conditional object and function-like macros
description: Implement README Phase 2 macro expansion while preserving divergent macro definitions as conditional data. The macro table must support object-like and function-like macros, and expansion must expose conditional token streams to the branch-aware parser.
acceptance_criteria: Macro definitions and expansions preserve branch conditions, support the listed C macro operators, and are validated through generated FileCheck fixtures plus preprocessor comparison against clang.

title: Phase 0: flat lexer and parser
description: Track the foundational non-conditional lexer and parser described in README Phase 0: tokens, the initial translation-unit AST, function definitions, compound statements, return statements, and integer constant expressions. This work is already implemented and is retained as a completed milestone for project history.
acceptance_criteria: The flat lexer and parser behavior is covered by the existing FileCheck fixtures; no conditional preprocessing or sema is required for this phase.
close_reason: Phase 0 flat lexer and parser is already implemented and covered by existing FileCheck fixtures.

title: Phase 1: conditional preprocessing and branch-aware parsing
description: Track README Phase 1: conditional directives, condition-stack representation, Conditional AST nodes, interleaved branch points in declaration and statement lists, and branch-aware typedef-name tracking for grammar disambiguation. The currently implemented subset is retained as the baseline for completing this phase.
acceptance_criteria: Conditional branches and typedef-sensitive parsing are represented in the polyvariant AST and covered by FileCheck fixtures; remaining phase gaps are explicit child tickets.

title: Expose semantic analysis as a TranslationUnit method
description: Refactor the semantic pass public API from a free function to TranslationUnit::analyze, keeping implementation helpers private and updating CLI call sites.
acceptance_criteria: TranslationUnit::analyze accepts -D defines and returns semantic errors; no public free-function entry point remains; CLI behavior and FileCheck coverage are unchanged; cargo fmt, cargo test, and cargo clippy pass.
close_reason: Semantic analysis is exposed as TranslationUnit::analyze and the CLI uses it.

title: Implement configuration-aware semantic pass and CLI diagnostics
description: Create the first semantic-analysis pass over the evaluated concrete AST, accepting -D defines and returning multiple structured diagnostics. Hook it into the parse command so semantic errors render through the existing miette diagnostic path after parsing succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: A public semantic API accepts TranslationUnit and -D defines and returns a list of errors; conditionals are evaluated for supplied defines; independent semantic errors aggregate; parse CLI prints semantic diagnostics similarly to parser diagnostics and exits nonzero; valid fixtures remain unchanged and invalid semantic fixtures are covered by generated FileCheck.
close_reason: Implemented configuration-aware semantic validation and CLI diagnostics with aggregated errors and generated FileCheck coverage.

title: Phase 6: configuration-aware semantic validation pass
description: Add a semantic validation phase after preprocessing and AST evaluation. The pass accepts the polyvariant TranslationUnit plus a list of -D defines, evaluates the AST for that configuration, validates that the resulting concrete program is well formed, and returns a list of diagnostics instead of panicking or stopping at the first error. The phase should grow from declaration/type/name validation into broader C semantic checks while remaining separate from parsing and code generation.
design: Run eval once per requested macro configuration, then validate the monomorphic ConcreteTranslationUnit. Keep the polyvariant AST free of semantic conclusions. Represent diagnostics as structured errors with stable messages and provenance, and reserve target/type-system details for child tickets.
acceptance_criteria: A public semantic pass API accepts a TranslationUnit and -D define list and returns an ordered list of semantic errors; conditional branches are evaluated using the supplied defines before validation; multiple independent errors are reported in one run; diagnostics identify the relevant declaration or source provenance; parser behavior remains separate; generated FileCheck or equivalent integration coverage exercises valid and invalid configurations.

title: Parse record and type layout attributes
description: Extend typed attribute parsing for record and type layout attributes based on clang-ir fixtures, including aligned(integer), packed trailing placement, vector_size(integer), mode(name), and field-level packed/aligned forms where the grammar supports them.
acceptance_criteria: Known record/type layout attributes have typed enum variants and preserve source order/payloads on records, typedefs, and fields; generated FileCheck coverage uses clang-ir aligned, packed_aligned, vector, and mode examples; malformed payloads produce diagnostics.
close_reason: Implemented typed record/type layout attributes with generated FileCheck coverage, including aligned, vector_size, mode, field attachment, and trailing packed placement.

title: Parse function and declaration attributes
description: Extend typed attribute parsing for GNU declaration attributes used by clang-ir, including visibility(string), section(string), weak, used, retain, noinline, always_inline, noreturn, constructor, destructor, nonnull(indices), annotate(string), target(string), alias(string), weakref(string), malloc, pure, and related declaration/function forms.
acceptance_criteria: Known function/declaration attributes have typed enum variants and attach to functions, declarations, typedefs, parameters, and fields where permitted; before/after placement and ordered lists are preserved; generated FileCheck coverage validates representative clang-ir fixtures and malformed syntax diagnostics.

title: Parse C23 and unknown attributes losslessly
description: Add C23 [[attribute]] spelling and an opaque/raw typed attribute fallback so unsupported attributes are retained rather than discarded. Cover deprecated(message), noreturn, nodiscard, maybe_unused, fallthrough, and namespace-qualified forms where practical.
acceptance_criteria: C23 attributes parse into typed variants when known and an opaque variant when unknown; placement and arguments are preserved; generated FileCheck coverage includes C23 fixtures and unknown attributes; malformed attribute syntax produces diagnostics.

title: Parse packed attributes on records
description: Implement and test GNU __attribute__((packed)) on struct and union declarations, preserving it as a typed Attribute enum in the polyvariant AST.
acceptance_criteria: Attribute::Packed is present on struct and union records; generated FileCheck coverage validates the parsed polyvariant form; cargo fmt, cargo test, and cargo clippy pass.
close_reason: Packed attribute parsing and generated FileCheck coverage were implemented before the attribute work was split into subtickets.

title: Parse GNU and C23 attributes into typed AST enums
description: Add source-level attribute parsing based on the attribute forms exercised by ~/Projects/clang-ir. Represent attributes as a dedicated enum with typed payloads rather than raw strings, and attach ordered attribute lists to structs, unions, enums, functions, declarations, typedefs, and fields/parameters where C permits them. Preserve unknown attributes through an explicit opaque/raw variant so parsing does not discard source information. Initial coverage should include packed, aligned(integer), visibility(string), section(string), weak, used, retain, noinline, always_inline, noreturn, constructor, destructor, nonnull(parameter indices), annotate(string), target(string), and deprecated(message). Support GNU __attribute__((...)) placement before/after declarations and C23 [[...]] spelling where practical. Use clang-ir fixtures such as packed_aligned_struct.c, aligned_struct.c, visibility/main.c, used_retain/main.c, noreturn_prototype.c, nonnull_prototype.c, allocation_attribute_metadata.c, and c23_language.c as parser references.
design: Use a Vec<Attribute> on each declaration-like AST node rather than booleans scattered across node types. Keep semantic interpretation out of parsing. Model attributes with typed enum variants for known forms and preserve unsupported forms in Raw/Opaque(String) so extensions remain lossless.
acceptance_criteria: Attributes are represented by a public typed enum with explicit payloads and an opaque fallback; representative attributes parse on structs/unions/enums, functions, declarations, typedefs, fields, and parameters; source order and placement are preserved in the AST; generated FileCheck fixtures cover GNU and C23 forms and unknown attributes; malformed attribute syntax produces diagnostics; cargo fmt, cargo test, and cargo clippy pass.
notes:
Packed slice implemented: Attribute::Packed is parsed on struct/union prefixes and preserved in polyvariant rendering, with generated FileCheck coverage in tests/fixtures/packed.c. Remaining work includes trailing placement and other attribute variants.
Work split into child tickets 1tx.1 through 1tx.4. Child 1tx.1 (packed records) is complete; remaining attribute families are tracked separately.

title: Separate polyvariant filechecks from Clang AST oracle
description: Update filechecking so the polyvariant AST is validated only against preprocessing-aware FileCheck expectations, while the evaluated AST is the sole comparison against Clang post-sema output. Ensure the oracle comparison reflects only declarations visited by the evaluated AST and add regression coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Polyvariant output is not compared to clang; evaluated output is compared to clang under each define configuration; unvisited conditional declarations do not cause mismatches; tests pass.
close_reason: Separated evaluated AST oracle naming and documented the preprocessing/evaluation comparison boundary; verified reachability behavior.

title: Set miette parser diagnostics to C syntax highlighting
close_reason: Configured miette parser sources with C syntax highlighting.

title: Add parser diagnostics with thiserror and miette
close_reason: Added typed miette parser diagnostics, Result propagation through main, and an autogenerated failing-parser fixture checked through stderr FileCheck.

title: Extract compiler argument parsing into CompilerArgParser
close_reason: Added compiler_args module with CompilerArgParser for -D and -std options; main no longer parses compiler arguments inline.

title: Refactor renderer to write AST output
close_reason: Renderer now owns a generic Write target and renders AST plus evaluated AST directly; all checks pass.

title: Refactor top-level parsing into a parser struct
close_reason: Introduced Parser as the top-level parsing facade with source, file, declaration, and internal parsing methods; all checks pass.

title: Remove redundant translation-unit evaluation wrapper
close_reason: Removed the redundant eval_translation_unit wrapper; callers now invoke TranslationUnit::eval directly.

title: Move declaration and declarator helpers onto AST impls
close_reason: Moved declaration, declarator, condition, conditional, translation-unit, declaration, and statement evaluation helpers onto their owning types; all checks pass.

title: Filter AST to reachable declarations
description: Included headers currently inject every typedef/declaration into the rendered translation unit. Add a reachability pass so the public polyvariant/concrete AST contains primary-source roots plus transitive declarations needed by referenced names, types, tags, calls, and conditional branches. Preserve the full include environment internally for lookup, but omit unused header declarations such as ULONG_MAX_TYPE and MyConfigType from includes.c.
design: Use provenance to distinguish primary-file roots from included declarations. Index declarations by symbol/tag. Traverse identifiers and type references from roots, recursively marking dependencies. Treat conditional branches as a union for polyvariant reachability; concrete evaluation may then remove inactive branches. Keep macro definitions/preprocessor state separate from declaration reachability.
acceptance_criteria: Unused declarations from included headers are absent from FileCheck output; a source declaration that references a header typedef/tag/prototype retains that dependency; reachability is computed over all possible conditional branches before concrete evaluation and rechecked after branch selection.
notes: Added src/reachability.rs and applied it during parsing. Primary-file declarations are roots; included declarations are indexed by symbol and retained only when referenced through named/ tagged types, pointers, arrays, function return types, or parameters. Conditional branches are filtered after reachability is computed, so possible branch dependencies remain polyvariant and inactive concrete branches disappear. Updated includes.c to prove unused header typedefs are omitted and added includes_reachable.c to prove a referenced header typedef is retained. Clang comparison now requires every exposed summary to exist in clang while intentionally ignoring clang-only unused header declarations. Validation: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, generator freshness, and git diff --check pass.
close_reason: Reachability filtering implemented and fixture coverage proves unused includes are omitted while referenced typedef dependencies remain.

title: Expand clang oracle coverage for Phase 3 AST shapes
description: Extend the clang comparison tests beyond summarized returns/typedefs to compare normalized declarations, types, declarators, records, arrays, function pointers, and initializers. Pin normalization to the clang version documented by the project.
acceptance_criteria: Each implemented Phase 3 slice has a clang-backed regression test and normalization clearly documents intentionally ignored clang-only details.
notes: The oracle comparison intentionally does not require our AST to mirror clang. It normalizes both sides to semantic facts: declaration identity, base type, array extents, function-vs-function-pointer category, return-pointer status, parameter types, variadicness, typedef types, and evaluated returns. Clang qualType spelling is only an input to this normalization; our FileCheck output remains our own AST shape. This lets clang expose missing behavior without making its AST schema our design.

title: Parse qualifiers and storage classes
description: Support const, volatile, restrict, _Atomic where applicable, typedef, extern, static, auto, register, and inline in the parse-only AST, including their valid declaration-specifier combinations.
acceptance_criteria: Qualifier/storage-class combinations are retained in AST tests and invalid combinations fail with useful parser diagnostics.
close_reason: Added qualifier and storage-class parsing, pointer/function qualifier retention, enum conversion helpers, rendered AST coverage, and invalid storage-class diagnostics.

title: Parse initializers and designated initializers
description: Add scalar, aggregate, string, compound, nested, and designated initializers, including array-index and struct-field designators. Keep initializer expressions polyvariant where conditionals occur.
acceptance_criteria: Representative initializer forms parse and preserve source order/designators; clang-backed tests cover nested aggregates and designated fields.
close_reason: Implemented initializer AST/parser/rendering/evaluation, conditional initializer support, generated fixture coverage, and documented FileCheck regeneration workflow.

title: Implement integer constant expressions for grammar decisions
description: Add integer constant folding sufficient for #if, array bounds, enumerator values, case labels, and static assertions as required by Phase 3 parsing. Keep this separate from full semantic analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Supported constant expressions fold consistently with clang for grammar-dependent cases, and unsupported expressions produce explicit diagnostics rather than silent values.
notes: Evaluator and current consumers are implemented and covered by FileCheck. Case labels and static assertions remain blocked on their parser/AST support, which does not yet exist.

title: Parse struct union and enum declarations
description: Add parse-only support for struct/union/enum definitions, forward declarations, fields, enumerators, anonymous records, and references. Track tags and typedef names sufficiently for grammar disambiguation.
acceptance_criteria: Representative record/union/enum declarations parse and match the corresponding clang AST structure; conditional declarations remain represented polyvariantly.
close_reason: Added parse-only struct, union, enum definitions, fields, forward declarations, anonymous records, tag references, typedef-tag aliases, rendering, reachability, and fixture/oracle coverage.

title: Parse arrays and function pointer declarators
description: Add postfix array declarators, multidimensional arrays, parameter lists, function declarators, pointer-to-function and function-returning-pointer composition, including parameter declarations.
acceptance_criteria: Nested array and function-pointer declarations parse with unambiguous AST structure and clang-oracle tests cover declaration permutations.
notes: Implemented declarator parsing in src/parser.rs and lexer support for char/void, pointers, brackets, commas, and ellipses. Added Declaration/ConcreteDecl integration, arrays, multidimensional arrays, function parameter lists, variadics, pointer-to-function, and function-returning-pointer coverage. Added clang type-spelling oracle tests. Validation: cargo test and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass.
close_reason: Array and function-pointer declarators implemented with parser unit tests and clang oracle coverage; tests and clippy pass.

title: Phase 3: full C declarator/type grammar
description: Expand the parser from the Phase 2 conditional/macro surface to the Phase 3 parse-only C grammar described in README.md. Keep the AST polyvariant and defer ordinary type checking to Phase 6. Validate each slice against clang AST output.
design: Implement grammar in dependency order: shared type/declarator representation, records/enums, arrays/function pointers, qualifiers/storage, initializers/designators, then constant-expression folding. Use comment-embedded FileCheck AST expectations for readable fixture tests.
acceptance_criteria: Phase 3 grammar work is decomposed into independently testable parser slices; all slices preserve conditional AST branches and have clang-backed coverage.

title: AST foundation: C types and declarators
description: Define the polyvariant AST representation for named/tagged types, pointers, arrays, function types, qualifiers, storage classes, and declarator composition. Preserve source/provenance and conditional branches without adding sema.
acceptance_criteria: The AST can represent every Phase 3 declarator/type shape needed by downstream parser slices, with structural unit tests.
notes: Added the Phase 3 AST foundation in src/ast.rs: richer CType variants for primitive/named/tagged/qualified/pointer/array/function types, declarator composition, parameters, qualifiers, storage classes, declaration specifiers, and deferred array-size expressions. Added structural unit tests. Updated the existing clang oracle normalization to remain exhaustive while dedicated Phase 3 oracle work is pending. Validation: cargo test and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass.
close_reason: AST type/declarator foundation and structural tests implemented; cargo test and clippy pass.
